value.rationale: The parameter-exact reduction of minimum absorber resources from five to three under a single arbitrarily weak bond defect is a sharp structural effect on a canonical Petersen quantum network. The persistent triple obstruction, cubic witness and finite-time/infinite-time distinction add interpretable mathematical content rather than a random finite parameter lookup.
